note: Official 55-trophy list (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze) as published for PS5. Guides below are original wording for this companion; each names the public sources its facts were cross-checked against.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, clear the story, then sweep activities, collectibles and the 100% completion tail. Keep a rolling backup save before each chapter finale so a missed story beat never forces a full replay.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles (official names, descriptions, grades)
Exophase GTA VI trophy listing (cross-check of counts)
steps: Check the tracker shows 54/54 before the final story mission.
The platinum pops on the last unlock screen.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing the opening mission Gone Fishing. Play the prologue through to its closing cutscene; there are no branching choices to get wrong here, so simply follow the objective markers to the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Follow the Gone Fishing objectives to completion.
Watch for the trophy on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 1. Before triggering the chapter finale, sweep the early missables flagged in this tracker (Ocean Beach cocktail, first partner crime) because chapter transitions can close free-roam windows.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Do the flagged missables before the finale.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's story arc. The name is reproduced exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Use Chapter 2 free-roam to bank early collectibles (cards, meditation spots) while the map is still opening up.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now most districts are reachable, so pair story progress with vehicle discovery (Whip It Good) and area exploration (The Goodtime State) to avoid a long cleanup tail later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Discover vehicles and areas as you travel.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Before the finale, finish any partner-dependent crimes (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) while both leads are freely available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Clear partner crimes before the finale.

trophies.guide: Gold trophy for completing the final story mission. Save in a fresh slot immediately before starting it. After the credits, free-roam continues for cleanup, so nothing needs to be rushed — but a pre-finale save protects you if a choice-gated trophy (Actions Speak Louder) needs a different branch.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Save in a new slot before the finale.
Continue into post-story free-roam for cleanup.

trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete Breakfast Run. It sits on the critical path, so it cannot be missed. Play it as soon as it unlocks to keep the chapter pacing tight.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Heists are good practice for the later vault and armored-truck crimes, so note the escape mechanics (breaking line of sight, swapping vehicles) while you play it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. Unmissable on the critical path. If a choice prompt appears, note it for Actions Speak Louder, which tracks choices across the whole game.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play Child's Play to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Critical-path trophy; no special conditions beyond finishing the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. The airport (VCIA) also hosts Catch Me If You Can, so after this mission, scout the airfield layout while you are there to make the later unscheduled-departure trophy easier.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late-story mission. Stock up on armor and ammunition beforehand; late missions punish under-equipped runs. Unmissable if you finish the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion — the long tail of the platinum. Track it in the in-game stats: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, properties and challenges all feed the percentage. Work it last, after the story, using this tracker's stage order so nothing is double-visited.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Clear strands, activities and collectibles by stage.
Buy remaining properties and finish challenges.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for 250 completed stunts. Stunts accumulate naturally while driving, but the fastest route is repeating a short, reliable stunt jump circuit once the map is open. Track your count in stats and chip away between other cleanup tasks rather than grinding in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Find a short repeatable stunt circuit.
Repeat until the stats counter reaches 250.
Mix with other cleanup to avoid burnout.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Do this early: it doubles as a tutorial tour of the map and unlocks the venues you will later grind (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling and more). Tick each type off in the tracker as you sample it.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Complete one round of each of the 9 types.
Trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy: gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Treat it as a skill grind — learn each weapon's recoil pattern, aim for headshot chains where targets allow, and retry immediately while the pattern is fresh. Split the 42 across several sessions.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Gold each challenge; retry failures at once.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Drone handling rewards smooth, early turns over raw speed. Clear locations district by district and mark each win in the tracker so none is revisited by mistake.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Win once at each of the 14 locations.
Tick locations off in the tracker.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (distinct events, not repeats of one). A tuned mid-tier car with good grip beats a fragile top-speed build on Leonida's mixed circuits. Log each distinct win; repeats do not advance the counter.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is timing-based: cast, wait for the bite cue, then reel steadily without snapping the line. If Cal wins the first attempt, retry immediately — the challenge stays available.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Retry on failure; it remains open.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to its ending or final stage. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through; partial plays do not count.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Trophy pops at the ending screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's full mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands unlock progressively, so check Andy's marker after each story chapter. Counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close his strand. Like Andy's, it feeds Strangers & Freaks. If Kenton's marker stalls, advance the story one mission and check again — strands often gate on story progress.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Advance story if the marker stalls.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is vehicle-flavoured, so bring a fast, durable ride to each stage. Feeds Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them; three more come from other strangers. Finish strands as they unlock rather than batching them at the end, since several gate on story chapters.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Include Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission to close his strand. Randy's jobs lean on deliveries and supply runs; keep a sturdy vehicle handy. Feeds Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Music-and-venue themed strand; clear it when its markers appear and it will count toward the 8-strand silver trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Sweep them district by district with the map fully open, and tick each spot in the tracker — 18 similar locations are easy to double-visit or skip. Pairs well with The Goodtime State exploration.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Visit and meditate at all 18 spots.
Tick each spot off in the tracker.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. This is flagged missable in this tracker: Bret's strand is the only source of the unique animal, so save before the final hunt. Use a quiet approach and a precise first shot; a spooked animal can end the attempt.
trophies.lockPoint: Bret's hunting strand — if the strand is abandoned or its final hunt is failed repeatedly without retry, the unique animal may not respawn. Save before Bret's final hunt and reload on failure.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Advance Bret's strand to the unique hunt.
Take the animal cleanly; reload on failure.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards scatter across Leonida; collect opportunistically during story travel, then do a dedicated sweep with a map guide for the last cards of each set. Three full sets are required, not three cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Silver trophy: use WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a pure sweep — work region by region and log every location in the tracker. 100 is the largest collectible count in the list, so start early and never pass a marked spot without using it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use WAiNK It at every marked spot you pass.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more; many complete incidentally. Check the challenge list weekly in-game and target the short ones first to build momentum toward 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, raise a 4-star wanted level and then lose it entirely. Flagged missable here because it needs the partner in free-roam — clear it before the final mission. Escape by breaking line of sight, swapping vehicles out of sight, and staying hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.lockPoint: Needs your partner present in free-roam. Do it before the final mission; if partner availability changes after the finale, this can lock. Earn a 4-star wanted level together, then lose it completely.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Raise wanted level to 4 stars together.
Break line of sight and lose all stars.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level active the whole time. Pick three shops on one street to minimise travel, keep the heat on between them, and escape only after the third register. Clear before the finale while the partner is available.
trophies.lockPoint: Partner-dependent like Hot Together: clear before the final mission while both leads roam freely. The wanted level must stay active across all 3 robberies — losing it mid-chain resets the count.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Rob them in one chain, wanted level active throughout.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles — entering or closely inspecting a new model registers it. Vary your driving: steal, borrow and test-drive everything you see, and visit showrooms and parking structures for rare models. The counter only rises for first-time models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Enter every new vehicle model you see.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Set it up: gather a group of at least five hostiles (a gang operation or a wanted-level standoff works), activate Combat Focus at close range, and chain headshots before the meter drains. Retry freely — it never locks.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Activate Combat Focus at close range.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport): get airside and take off or leave by an unauthorised route. Scout the airfield during VCIA Takedown first. Expect a wanted response; plan the escape line before you move.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Scout VCIA during the story mission.

trophies.guide: The description is the clue: it involves Rhinos (tanks) and heat. The tracker treats this as a Rhino encounter trophy — engage or evade Rhino armour when it appears at high wanted levels or in military-flavoured missions, and survive the encounter. Check the in-game trophy tracker after your first Rhino contact to confirm progress.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Reach a Rhino encounter (high heat or mission).
Confirm progress in the trophy tracker.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Scout the store first: note cameras, guards and the alarm. Move slowly, stay out of sightlines, take the loot and leave clean — any detection, even after grabbing the goods, voids the attempt. Retry as often as needed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Silver trophy: rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the heavy end of the crime ladder — bring armour, a fast escape car parked nose-out, and a pre-planned route that breaks line of sight. Five separate successful escapes are required.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Prepare armour and an escape car.
Rob a vault and escape cleanly.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Block the truck's path with a heavy vehicle, disable it quickly, take the cash and break line of sight before the response boxes you in. One clean success is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Stop it, rob it, grab the cash.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive or fly through every named district; the map greys out unvisited areas, so sweep the grey patches systematically. Combine with the meditation and WAiNK sweeps to cover the state once, thoroughly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Sweep grey patches until none remain.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked once discovered; work gang by gang and log each robbery in the tracker. Nine distinct gangs — robbing the same gang twice does not advance the count.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob one operation for each of 9 gangs.
Log each gang in the tracker.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet early-game moment: find the beachfront spot with the view, order the cocktail, and let the scene play. Flagged missable here — grab it in Chapter 1 while Ocean Beach is in its opening state.
trophies.lockPoint: Early-game moment on Ocean Beach. The tracker flags it missable because beachfront venues and partner availability can change as chapters advance — do it in Chapter 1 free-roam, the first time Ocean Beach opens.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Chapter 1.
Find the cocktail spot with the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: take a showroom car and drive it through the glass frontage. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up inside, build speed, and exit through the windows rather than the door. Expect immediate heat — keep driving.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Smash out through the glass front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through interaction. Visit the alley, start a game, and play it through. Note the exact published name uses a curly apostrophe (Let’s), reproduced here as PlayStation lists it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This tracker groups it with the partner trophies: complete the partner activity chain in free-roam before the finale. If it does not pop after one activity, check the in-game tracker — partnership trophies often count a series of shared activities.
trophies.lockPoint: Partnership trophy: depends on partner activities in free-roam. Clear it alongside Hot Together and Retail Therapy before the final mission, while both leads are available.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Check the in-game tracker for progress.
Finish the chain before the finale.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: PlayStation tracks a choice count (toward 500) across the story. Engage with every choice prompt instead of skipping, and keep the pre-finale backup save. If the count stalls after the credits, reload the backup and take different branches.
trophies.lockPoint: Choice-tracking trophy (PSN tracks a count toward 500). Choices are made across the story; keep the pre-finale save so a different branch can be replayed if the count stalls. Do not overwrite the pre-finale slot.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Replay branches if the count stalls.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on a second attempt after failing it once. The reliable route is to deliberately fail a short repeatable task (a race or challenge), then immediately retry and succeed. If it has not popped by cleanup, use the in-game tracker hint to confirm the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a short repeatable task once.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a strange-encounter trophy. Leonida hides odd one-off events off the beaten path; explore remote areas, especially at night, and investigate anything that looks staged or out of place. The in-game tracker names the trigger once you are close.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore remote areas, especially at night.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian or rider with a melee swing as you pass. Use a slow vehicle on a quiet street for control, swing as you draw level, and expect a wanted star — drive away cleanly afterwards.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Take a slow vehicle on a quiet street.
Swing melee as you pass a target.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from crimes (vaults, trucks, operations); laundering converts them at a cut. Route every crime payout through contacts instead of spending marked cash directly, and track the running total in stats.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Launder through contacts, not direct spending.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops combined. This arrives naturally if you buy weapons, clothes, vehicle mods and supplies throughout the game; if it lags in cleanup, buy high-value mods and outfits. Shop spending only — property purchases are tracked separately.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear and mods throughout the game.
Top up with big purchases in cleanup.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages unlock as the map opens and story progresses; buy each as it becomes available if cash allows, or sweep the remainder in cleanup once laundering income (Dime on the Dollar) is flowing. All 8 are required.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Unlock garage properties via story and map.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or have discovered, and repeat until 10 are listed. Pairs naturally with Whip It Good's vehicle discovery — register models as you find them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
